title: Emboss notary certificate with desktop seal press
instruction: Emboss the official notary seal on the certificate card.
context: Paralegals and legal assistants (BLS SOC 23-2011: 352,000 workers), legal secretaries (BLS SOC 43-6012: 168,000 workers), and administrative assistants (BLS SOC 43-6014: 1,980,000 workers), representing over 2.5 million legal and administrative personnel, authenticate legal deeds, affidavits, diplomas, and corporate certificates daily using heavy-duty cast-iron desktop seal embosser presses. The bimanual operation requires holding the stiff certificate card aligned inside the die throat against the mechanical depth stop while depressing the long spring-return lever handle through a 35-degree stroke (~25 N compression force) to crimp the raised gold seal into the cardstock, and retracting both hands clear.
setup: Standard office desk counter (Z=0.7475 m). Center: heavy cast-iron desktop seal embosser press (200 x 80 x 140 mm, 2.50 kg) at (0.280, -0.060) m with non-slip rubber pads, upper/lower brass die platens at the throat opening, and spring-loaded chrome lever handle propped at 35 deg. Right side: stiff 300 gsm notary certificate card (120 x 80 x 1.5 mm) with gold foil seal target and grip pinch tab staged on desk at (0.280, 0.130) m. Bimanual coordination: left gripper grasps certificate tab and slides card 140 mm into the press throat stop; right gripper depresses lever knob down to seated crimp position.
scoring: Monotonic multi-stage progression: 0.20: certificate card grasped and advanced >40 mm toward press throat; 0.40: certificate seated squarely against internal depth stop (<20 mm alignment tolerance); 0.65: lever handle depressed past halfway point (q < 22.0 deg); 0.85: lever depressed to full crimp stop (q <= 6.0 deg) embossing seal impression; 1.00: both hands released and retracted clear (TCPs >= 45 mm, link hulls >= 10 mm clear) for >= 20 consecutive simulation steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz) with assembly resting still. Defect latches (0.0): press base sliding off anchor (>40 mm) or non-finite state.
reset_notes: Extract certificate card from press throat and re-stage on desk at (0.280, 0.130) m. Return spring lever handle to propped 35 deg rest position. Re-center press base at (0.280, -0.060) m.
fidelity: Rigid bodies and composite collision boxes for cast-iron platen base, vertical throat column, upper/lower brass die platens, spring-return chrome lever arm with spherical palm knob, and stiff 300 gsm cardstock certificate with gold foil seal. Authentic 1:1 desktop dimensions. Multi-stage physics-verified scoring with stillness hold requirement.
